name: record_action_trigger
prompt: Author a FortiSOAR playbook with a record_action trigger on the alerts module (right-click 'Triage Alert' button, one run per record). Read severity from `vars.input.records[0]` into a variable, decide High/Critical vs anything else, and on the high branch stamp a `verdict` variable of 'escalate'; the low branch ends. Output complete YAML.
notes: record_action trigger + severity decision + per-branch outcome

ir_assertions.note: the record_action trigger is bound to the alerts module
reads severity off the triggering record
both a high and a low arm
